job.name: l1p_ill_counter
job.style: Use the attached design board as the STRICT style reference: bold flat vector retail-pop illustration, no gradients or soft shading, thick clean shapes, palette of cobalt #2F4BFF, tangerine #FF7A1A, lime #C6F432, white #FFFFFF, ink #111433, simple flat skin tones. Playful geometric confetti accents. No text, no letters, no logos, no signs anywhere.
job.style_qa: плоская векторная поп-иллюстрация в палитре борда (кобальт/мандарин/лайм/белый/чернила), без градиентов, НЕ фото
job.person_note: The store administrator must resemble the woman in the attached photo (light-brown shoulder-length hair, dark navy polo) but drawn in the flat illustration style; her badge has no text.
job.meaning: возврат без конфликта: администратор у кассы спокойно и доброжелательно выслушивает покупателя, который вернулся с пакетом (в пакете свитер)
job.prompt: At a simple shop counter, a friendly woman store administrator in a dark navy polo calmly listens with a warm smile to a customer — a man in a casual jacket — holding an open shopping bag with a folded sweater. Relaxed, no tension. Flat colour-block background with a few big circles and confetti shapes. Both people visible from the waist up, generous empty space around them.
